stemMd: Which replacement is clearest? "The new roof [stopped water from making its way into] the reading room."

options.label: D
options.textMd: stopped the entrance of the wet substance into

explanationMd: The intended action is preventing water from entering. "Prevented leaks into" names that action directly without changing the meaning.

distractorRationale.d: This vague nominal phrase is unnecessarily indirect.
distractorRationale.c: Announcing does not mean preventing entry.
